title: Narasimha Ashtakam
intro: Narasimha Ashtakam is a powerful hymn dedicated to Lord Narasimha. Read the complete lyrics, meaning, and benefits.
description:
shrimadakalanka paripurna shashikoti-
shridhara manohara satapatala kanta ।
palaya kripalaya bhavambudhi-nimagnam
daityavarakala narasimha narasimha ॥ 1 ॥

padakamalavanata pataki-jananam
patakadavanala patatrivara-keto ।
bhavana parayana bhavartiharaya mam
pahi kripayaiva narasimha narasimha ॥ 2 ॥

tunganakha-pankti-dalitasura-varasrik
panka-navakunkuma-vipankila-mahorah ।
panditanidhana-kamalalaya namaste
pankajanisanna narasimha narasimha ॥ 3 ॥

maulishu vibhushanamivamara varanam
yogihridayesu cha shirassunigamanam ।
rajadarvinda-ruchiram padayugam te
dehi mama murdhni narasimha narasimha ॥ 4 ॥

varijavilocana madantima-dashayam
klesha-vivashikrita-samasta-karanayam ।
ehi ramaya saha sharanya vihaganam
nathamadhiruhya narasimha narasimha ॥ 5 ॥

hataka-kirita-varahara-vanamala
dhararashana-makarakundala-manindraih ।
bhushitamashesa-nilayam tava vapurme
chetasi chakastu narasimha narasimha ॥ 6 ॥

indu ravi pavaka vilochana ramayah
mandira mahabhuja-lasadvara-rathanga ।
sundara chiraya ramatam tvayi mano me
nandita suresha narasimha narasimha ॥ 7 ॥

madhava mukunda madhusudana murare
vamana nrisimha sharanam bhava natanam ।
kamada ghrinin nikhilakarana nayeyam
kalamamaresha narasimha narasimha ॥ 8 ॥

ashtakamidam sakala-pataka-bhayaghanam
kamadam ashesa-duritamaya-ripughnam ।
yah pathati santatamashesha-nilayam te
gachchhati padam sa narasimha narasimha ॥ 9 ॥

faq.q1: Which deity is this stotra dedicated to?
faq.a1: This sacred stotra is dedicated to Lord Narasimha, the fierce, protective, and merciful avatar of Lord Vishnu.
faq.q2: What is the main purpose and meaning of Shri Narasimha Ashtakam?
faq.a2: The main purpose of this stotra is to glorify the divine form, powerful claws, and majestic appearance of Lord Narasimha. In it, the devotee prays for His grace and refuge to overcome the sorrows and fears of the material world (samsara).
faq.q3: How many verses are there in this stotra?
faq.a3: This stotra contains a total of 9 verses (8 verses of praise, followed by a final phalashruti verse).
faq.q4: What are the benefits of reciting Shri Narasimha Ashtakam?
faq.a4: Regular and sincere recitation destroys all types of sins, fears, diseases, and enemies. According to the phalashruti, a devotee who recites it constantly attains the supreme abode of Lord Narasimha.
faq.q5: When should this stotra be recited?
faq.a5: It is considered extremely beneficial to recite it daily during the worship of Lord Narasimha, during times of crisis or fear, and on special occasions such as Narasimha Jayanti.
